descriptions.metaCapiDatasets: Manage Meta Conversions API datasets, pixels and access tokens.
descriptions.metaCapiDatasetSources: Bind WhatsApp / Instagram business accounts to a dataset and configure which funnel and stage their conversions create Opportunities in.
descriptions.metaConversionEvents: Review Click-to-WhatsApp / Instagram conversions captured from conversations, their attribution and any Opportunity created.
descriptions.metaCapiEventLog: Inspect events sent to the Meta Conversions API and their delivery status.
